notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Some of the floor counting was done improperly after floor 8 that could cause issues, this has been fixed.
[*]There was some incomplete flag data in a tileset, this has been fixed. 
[*]The game displayed incorrect buttons when using gamepad for the actions, this has been fixed.
[*]Collision error in first floor allowed walking on ceiling if entered from certain angle, this has been fixed.
[*]Preloading some bust assets could cause the game to freeze when using a boat to enter the next floor on Floor 9, this has been fixed.[/list]

[b]Lightning[/b]

[list][*]Tweaked light passability settings for floors 5 and above
[*]Changed the light levels for floor 4[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]

[list][*]Various optimizations to scripts
[*]Random generated floors now have less lag[/list]

notes.title: Full version release!
notes.content:
[h1]THIS IS AN EXTREMELY MAJOR RELEASE UPDATE! EARLY ACCESS VERSION SAVES DO NO LONGER WORK!!!![/h1]

[b]Achievement[/b]

[list][*]"Brew this!", brew everything in alchemy
[*]"So much to see!", obtain 100% completion in gallery
[*]"True heroine!", save every NPC from the dungeon and have them move back to town[/list]

[b]Alchemy[/b]

[list][*]You can now brew potions using Alchemy[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]

[list][*]Message sounds are now more infrequent
[*]Message sounds play at lower volume
[*]Message sounds take into consideration different localizations better
[*]Footsteps now make noise, this can also be turned off[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]

[list][*]Magic seller now also sells all second tier spells in additonal to third tier spells[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Using "Clear equipment" now no longer causes item dublications.[/list]

[b]CG[/b]

[list][*]Added CG gallery where you can see the unlockable arts of CG, Character Art and Background Art
[*]Losing to Morrigan has an unique defeat CG
[*]Winning Morrigan unlocks unique victory CG
[*]Sex with Natsumi is now shown with CG[/list]

[b]Controls[/b]

[list][*]Using keyboard + Mouse, you can use mouse to aim and WASD to move. This can be used to point your flashlight to directions without moving, when exploring the dungeon.
[*]Keyboard controls now has lots of useful macros, such as the button I opens up the items menu.
[*]The game now recognizes if using the gamepad and tells the correct buttons based on the controller used[/list]

[b]Corescript[/b]

[list][*]Updated to 1.70  (was 1.44)[/list]

[b]Dungeon[/b]

[list][*]First Floor now spans across two maps
[*]Added new Eight Floor, which is dedicated to puzzle solving and physics 
[*]Moved the original Fourth Floor to work as Ninth Floor
[*]Moved the original Fifth Floor to work as Tenth Floor
[*]Dungeon layout is now randomized on floors 2, 3,  5,  6 and 7. [/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Added Alchemy
[*]Added "Heal All" automatic system, where you can with a press of a button use items to fully recover fully recover the party's HP, MP, and status by using lower cost items first to higher cost ones. 
[*]Added Map, which you can open per each map that gets uncovered when you explore the areas, it's automatically shown at  the town
[*]Skill trainer is now bound somewhere inside the floor 2 and must be found before he joins the city
[*]Miner is now bound somewhere inside the floor 6 and must be found before he joins the city
[*]Friendly witch NPC can be found on the last floor of the dungeon and will join the city when found[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Zoomed the play area closer for a better visual effect
[*]Added Depth of Field
[*]Added Fog
[*]Morrigan has a new battle sprite
[*]Improved the way bust graphics are drawn, shown and removed during dialogues
[*]Busts now have a breathing animation in cutscenes
[*]Added Smooth Scrolling of map when moving this can be disabled for performance on lower-end systems
[*]Character busts now display emotions during the battle
[*]Added Lightning Effects, this can be disabled for performance on lower-end systems
[*]Added Weather Effects for the main city, these can be toned down for performance on lower-end systems
[*]Running now kicks up dust clouds, this can be disabled for performance on lower-end systems[/list]

[b]Loot[/b]

[list][*]Slimes now have 50% chance to drop Slime Drops
[*]Slimes now have a rare chance to drop Health Brews
[*]Slimes now ave a very rare chance to drop Energizers
[*]Goblins now have a rare chance to drop Health Brews
[*]Goblins now have a very rare chance to drop Energizers
[*]Goblins have 25% chance to drop Purified Water
[*]Increased chance that Zombies may drop Holy Water
[*]Zombies now have 50% chance to drop Purified Water
[*]Sir Blob has 50% chance to drop Slime Drops 
[*]Killer Plants have 50% chance to drop Purified Water[/list]

[b]Messages[/b]

[list][*]Added Message Log that records all the messages in game[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]

[list][*]Optimized all the music for smaller size to help with loading times[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]

[list][*]Numerous optimizations[/list]

[b]Tutorials[/b]

[list][*]Added Tutorials to the game, these can be disabled if desired[/list]

[b]UI [/b]

[list][*]Completely reworked the battle UIs
[*]Completely reworked the dialogue UIs
[*]Completely reworked the save menu UI
[*]Bosses now have a bigger health bar
[*]Each Gauge now has unique and more relevant colors for their text
[*]Each Gauge has a more sleek design instead of being plain squares
[*]Added sub-category "Datalog" main menu, which opens up to reveal Quest Journal, Message Log and Battle Data Log
[*]Added compass 
[*]Added Map which is revealed in dungeons as you play and completely in the main hub
[*]Floor number is now shown on the menu screen
[*]Floor number is now shown on save files[/list]

notes.title: Full version is coming this month!
notes.content:
[h1]Full version is approaching!![/h1]

Greetings Climax Heroines fans! I come bearing good news! After months of hard work and polish, the game's finally going to have a full version release this year on November! 

I repeat

[h2]The full version of the game will be released on November 2023, with exact date being revealed later[/h2]

The game's receiving an absolute massive overhaul of many elements, the game is bigger, looks prettier and runs better too. The game will also feature some floors that are randomized, making each playthrough potentially unique. I am working as much as I can on the full release, so I'll make another news which will tell when we know the exact date we can make the full version release.

[h3]If you don't own the game yet, now is a great time to wishlist it![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1891560/Climax_Heroines/

notes.title: We finally have a new release date!
notes.content:
[h1]It took longer than expected but we were able to crush all the bugs we found and few more, that we hadn't seen before![/h1]

As of now, the game will be able to be released!

[h2]The new release date is Mach 1st of 2022![/h2]

This will coincidentally mark as five year anniversary for Tuomo's Games as well. Here's hoping that all of you will enjoy Climax Heroines.

notes.title: There's going to be a small delay
notes.content:
[h1]I regret to inform that the game probably cannot meet its 15th target date[/h1]

There were some bugs that still need to be addressed and there were big problems in cloud save functionality.  One of the bugs literally prevented game progression and would have made it impossible to finish the game.  

[h2]We will inform you when we can release the game. [/h2]

This delay isn't a major one, so at most this is one week long delay but if all goes well, the release may come even sooner. Wishlist the game to get notified when the new release date is revealed.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1891560/Climax_Heroines/

I ask for your patience. Due to these issues, I cannot on good confidence release the game on 15th as it would not meet the quality standards.

Sincerely,
Tuomo
